checks: At 1672, 1000 and 390 pixels: select, combine and use work through actual mouse clicks; actions remain in the viewport without scrolling or opening the inventory modal. Supply and ammo badges show exact counts.

Normal automatically removes the access card only after both matching locks open, preserving useful supplies, lighter and weapon. Nightmare retains the spent card until confirmed manual discard; discard returns to the room.
Paused carry, combine, heal, recharge and storage commands do not mutate inventory, battery or condition.
